population.description: Per-context-build duration (ms) of the native Graphiti recall context hook in the disposable source-scoped probe, measured around the branch-staged plugin's context handler (search await + format + system push).
population.runs: 3 prompt turns (real question, short 'ok', repeated real question) across 3 fresh standalone OpenCode processes; 19 context builds total (17 within the first turn's tool loop).

method_notes: Network time INCLUDED: cold-process builds perform a fresh Graphiti MCP initialize + search_memory_facts round trip (127.0.0.1:8766) inside the 300 ms race allowance.
No prewarming cache across processes: each `opencode run --standalone` is a fresh process; warm in-turn builds reuse the in-flight search promise (~0.02-0.05 ms).
p95=256.92 ms <= 300 ms guard (43.08 ms headroom). The 256.92 ms case is the cold-process worst case in this population.
verdict: PASS (p95 <= 300 ms) on the observed disposable-host population; fresh-client re-measure required for the installed-post-merge gate.
